change.description: AgentClient resolves app.locals.nostromoSiwcConnectionService, matching the service property registered by SiwcConnectionService.registerLibreChat. Previously it looked up app.locals.nostromoSiwc and silently bypassed the authenticated SIWC resolver.

test.scope: focused SOURCE patch generation, fail-closed and bootstrap tests; not live AgentClient or OAuth

host_after_test.interpretation: CPU pressure was elevated in a short post-test sample. NOSTROMO processes showed low CPU; the sample does not establish causality. No memory pressure observed. No additional build/full-suite run started.

deployment: NOT_APPLIED; productive upstream and backend untouched
next: Revalidate full local CI against the committed candidate when CPU contention subsides; keep LIVE SIWC blocked until authenticated route-input readback, owner OAuth consent, and exact HOST_CONTROL deployment/restart authorization are available.
